title: Enmascara strategy fixtures
description: Values masked with each strategy. partial and hmac work on the canonical value: NFKC per character, upper case, without default-ignorable characters, keeping only 0-9, A-Z, Ñ and &. hmac is HMAC-SHA256 of 'type:canonical' with the UTF-8 key, written as [TYPE:first 6 hex characters].

key.description: Test key shared by the hmac cases; never use it in production.
